_meta: English is the source language. Keys are grouped by area. {name} marks a value filled in by the code.
lang.label: Language
nav.label: Student navigation
offline.text: You are offline. Your answers are kept while this page stays open and are saved when you are back online. Please do not close this page.
offline.disconnected: The connection to the lesson was lost. Your changes are kept while this page stays open and will sync when it returns.
offline.synced: Back online. Your changes have been saved.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.message: We could not open this page. Check your connection and try again. If it keeps happening, tell your teacher the code below.
error.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it yourself.
error.expired: Your sign-in may have expired. Reload the page and sign in again.
error.offline: You seem to be offline. Check your connection.
tab.other: This page is open in another tab. Changes made there may overwrite changes made here. Please close one of the tabs.
skew.ahead: Your device clock is about {minutes} minutes ahead. Lesson timers use the server's time, but due dates may look wrong. Check your date and time settings.
skew.behind: Your device clock is about {minutes} minutes behind. Lesson timers use the server's time, but due dates may look wrong. Check your date and time settings.
storage.degraded: This browser is not letting the portal save on your device. Your progress is still saved online, but your settings and offline copies are not kept.
feature.notEnabled: {feature} is not switched on for your account. If you think it should be, ask your teacher.
